args.subject: Child seat availability in London
args.body:
Hello New Car Rental,

Do you have child seats available with your car rentals in London? If so, could you please let me know which types are available and whether there is an additional charge?

Thank you,
Emma Johnson

final_text: I emailed New Car Rental at **support@newcarrental.co.uk**, the address listed in the customer review, asking whether child seats are available in London, which types they offer, and whether there’s an extra charge.
